class.name: OIDCTokenOnDemand
class.description: A build feature that allows build configurations to request short-lived JWTs for OIDC authentication.

function.name: oidcTokenOnDemand
function.description: Allow a build configuration to request short-lived JWTs for OIDC authentication during the build.

param.name: audiences
param.description: Newline-separated list of allowed audience values for the `aud` claim in the JWT. When empty, only the default audience (== `iss` claim) is allowed.

example.description: Allow issuing JWTs for multiple audiences.
